video_title: We DEBATE if Donovan Mitchell is as good as Jokic, Luka and Shai 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Donovan Mitchell needs a salary sacrifice to build a championship team
quotes.excerpt: if you want to build a championship team, he needs to take a sacrifice

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: My statement is that if you want to build a championship team, he needs to take a sacrifice because you need a better team.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: But you said five or six people can do that.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I think about seven or eight can get paid. Who? I think my personal opinion off the rip is Jokic, Shai, Luka is a true franchise player in my opinion offensively, he can draw that much attention. I think Giannis is, yeah, I would say Giannis.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva explains why Steph Curry and LeBron James create unique defensive gravity
quotes.excerpt: Steph moves without the ball which causes your defense to be under a lot of stress

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I think you can guard Donovan Mitchell with a one-on-one player like Scottie Barnes, so it's going to be tougher for him to win a championship. I think teams are willing to live with that. The reason why I said Steph was an anomaly initially was because Steph moves without the ball which causes your defense to be under a lot of stress all the time. You have to make quick decisions and teams typically can't do that. The reason why LeBron James was there is because LeBron James is a 6'8 freight train. So if he's going downhill, or if he's going to the cup, you have to either send two and he can get an open look. Jokic is so efficient in the paint that you probably have to send more.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues that high-paid stars must ensure their team has enough money to pay others
quotes.excerpt: if you're going to take that much money, you have to know that you're going to have enough money to pay other people

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Ultimately, we said something that if everyone wants to build a very good basketball team, everyone has to do it. So that means your four or five guys can't make that money either. Why hasn't Steph won? If you say he has all that gravity, if Steph is healthy in his prime, if he can do it by himself, why has he not won? If Jokic can do it by himself, we're talking about with the money that you are making now. Steph is not making 70 million dollars. You're saying he's not worth the 70. Who is worth the 70?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: I didn't say he wasn't worth the 70. Stop putting words in my mouth. I think you need that extra 15 to 20 million to get the team you need.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva clarifies his stance on team building and player gravity
quotes.excerpt: you say he needs more help around him, so our points are kind of the exact same

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: To your point specifically, is that you say he needs more help around him. So our points are kind of the exact same. You just believe you can do it with that money being taken up. I think you need that extra 15 to 20 million to get the team you need. Because you literally said the team matters and you need more money and you need the team to work around them. So we're having the same point. Because I just don't think he's on the level of a Steph or LeBron where defenses have to make adjustments and gear their game plan a lot more to him and make a lot more changes. He can make more money because he opens up the floor more for his teammates. So I'm done talking about it because the chat's done.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Nigga, you are so worried about what everyone else thinks. We are having a fucking conversation.
